items.title: Claude Fable 5.2 (xhigh) leads WeirdML v3 at 43.0%, ahead of GPT 6 Astra
items.summary: The WeirdML author reports Fable 5.2 at xhigh effort scoring 43.0% on v3, ahead of GPT 6 Astra, which is more token efficient. Only the Mystery Box task without hints shows no real progress.

items.title: Seedream 5.5 live on fal: multi-turn image editing, in-image text edits, layer separation
items.summary: fal added Seedream 5.5 for image generation and editing, with multi-turn refinement, direct text edits inside images, and splitting an image into editable layers, via hosted text-to-image, edit and layerize endpoints.

doubt.pushback: Launch post only; no benchmark or independent test shown.

items.title: Deletion Tuning: zeroing under 0.05% of weights matches full fine-tuning in LLM post-training
items.summary: An NYU and Calgary paper (NeurIPS 2026) learns a binary mask over gate projections that zeroes under 0.05% of weights and matches full fine-tuning across RLVR, SFT and on-policy distillation, with masks far smaller than a checkpoint and less forgetting than full fine-tuning or LoRA.

doubt.pushback: Summary is from an aggregator post; the claims are not independently reproduced and no code link was seen.

items.title: Meta FAIR e-means: k-means variant with 10-45x GPU speedups, 10B DINO embeddings into 16M clusters
items.summary: A Meta FAIR paper replaces batch k-means with mini-batch exponential moving average updates, reports 10-45x GPU speedups over leading k-means implementations, and clusters 10 billion DINO embeddings into 16 million clusters in 2.5 epochs without a hyperparameter sweep.

doubt.pushback: Summary is from an aggregator post; no code link seen and numbers not independently reproduced.

items.title: Bogen: free tool that lets Claude Code and Codex design UIs without a separate design subscription
items.summary: The author launched Bogen, a free design tool that coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) drive to produce consistent screens, themes and plugins, with a demo video and a site to try.

doubt.pushback: Early launch with no independent test or sample output beyond the author's own video.
